# LLM entry point

Primary instructions: `AGENTS.md`
Research design: `PROJECT_PLAN.md`
Live checklist: `reports/PREP_STATUS.md`
Run history: `reports/CHANGELOG_RUNS.md`
Known pitfalls: `reports/MISTAKES.md`
Course corpus: `llm_corpus/INDEX.md`

Core rule: all models receive identical prompts. Ordinary CV is grouped by `prompt_id`; cross-genre evaluation withholds a complete `task_type`; cross-family transfer is run in both directions and includes an unseen-prompt robustness test.
Core claim limit: results concern transfer between the selected version pairs and genres, not a universal LLM generation effect.
